'''December 2000 Clifton Park tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Gamers Guild, Clifton Park, NY in December 2000. [[Brian Terwilliger]] won it. It is known from Brian Terwilliger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1586">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-31-twigg-the-battle-for-reflections-2d1586/ twigg-the-battle-for-reflections-2], DeckTech (Brian "twigg" Terwilliger, 31 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-31-twigg-the-battle-for-reflections-2d1586/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' December 2000
* '''Site:''' Gamers Guild, Clifton Park, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 25
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Terwilliger]]
